query: SELECT DISTINCT npc_round.root_sequence_id FROM npc_round              WHERE npc_round.state IN ('collecting', 'selected', 'executing') AND (                  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_candidate                          JOIN invocation ON invocation.id = npc_candidate.decision_invocation_id                          WHERE npc_candidate.round_id = npc_round.id AND invocation.outcome = 'interrupted')                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_candidate                             JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = npc_candidate.execution_sequence_id                             WHERE npc_candidate.round_id = npc_round.id AND sequence.error = ?1)                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_round_source                             JOIN action ON action.requesting_tool_execution_id = npc_round_source.source_tool_execution_id                             JOIN speech ON speech.action_id = action.id                             JOIN speech_batch ON speech_batch.id = speech.batch_id                             JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = speech_batch.sequence_id                             WHERE npc_round_source.round_id = npc_round.id AND sequence.error = ?1))
